title: Homework in Primary Schools
text:
Many people argue that homework should be abolished in primary schools. They claim that young children need time to play, rest, and spend time with their families. Supporters of this view also point out that long hours of study can reduce a child's interest in learning. However, research on this issue is far from conclusive.

Opponents, on the other hand, believe that small amounts of homework help children develop discipline and reinforce what they learned in class. They argue that without regular practice, pupils may forget important skills. For this reason, many teachers recommend short, purposeful tasks rather than long assignments. A balanced approach may therefore satisfy both sides of the debate.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do supporters of abolishing homework claim young children need?
options: time to play, rest and spend time with their families
more lessons at school every day

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do opponents believe small amounts of homework help children develop?
options: discipline and reinforcement of what they learned in class

questions.text: What can be inferred about the author's position on homework?
options: The author is neutral and sees value on both sides
The author strongly opposes all homework
The author believes homework has no effect on children
The author wants longer school days

questions.text: Why might teachers recommend short, purposeful tasks instead of long assignments?
options: Because long tasks may reduce children's interest in learning
Because long assignments are required by law
Because children never finish long tasks at all
Because short tasks are cheaper to print

to make an idea or skill stronger through repetition
done with a clear aim or reason

paragraph_translations: Багато людей стверджують, що домашнє завдання слід скасувати в початковій школі. Вони вважають, що маленьким дітям потрібен час для гри, відпочинку та спілкування з родиною. Прихильники цієї точки зору також зазначають, що тривале навчання може знизити інтерес дитини до знань. Проте дослідження з цього питання далеко не переконливі.

Противники, навпаки, вважають, що невеликий обсяг домашніх завдань допомагає дітям розвивати дисципліну та закріплювати те, що вони вивчили на уроці. Вони стверджують, що без регулярної практики учні можуть забути важливі навички. Саме тому багато вчителів рекомендують короткі, цілеспрямовані завдання замість довгих. Збалансований підхід таким чином може задовольнити обидві сторони дискусії.
